ideas.title: The Impact of $19 Billion Alleged Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the alleged $19 billion fraud in Minnesota, its implications, and the entities involved.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and analyze the impact on Minnesota's economy and public trust.
questions: What are the sources of the alleged fraud?
How does this impact Minnesota's economy?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover the extent of financial mismanagement in Minnesota and the effectiveness of current oversight measures.

ideas.title: The Rise of Protests Against ICE
ideas.description: An analysis of the nationwide protests against ICE, focusing on the events in Minneapolis.
ideas.angle: Investigate the causes and impact of these protests on communities and law enforcement.
questions: What are the main concerns driving these protests?
How are law enforcement agencies responding?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on public sentiment towards ICE and the broader implications for immigration policy.
